goal: Catch Guix build breakages, missing imports, and manifest errors early in CI
Prevent release blockers for maintainers when producing release binaries
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (fanquake, sedited)
Previous objections regarding duplicate builds and cache settings resolved (hebasto)
Suggested running tests rather than only catching build errors (maflcko)
Open question on whether to rely solely on the author's Guix substitute servers

categories.name: build
why: P2 because continuous Guix testing catches build failures before release creation
Saves maintainers from late-cycle release disruptions caused by missing imports or manifest errors
